SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
Patient ID: PT-000073
Specimen: Core needle biopsy / surgical tissue resection of primary tumor.

GROSS & MICROSCOPIC EXAMINATION:
Specimen consists of multiple fibrous tissue cores exhibiting invasive malignant epithelial neoplasm consistent with Melanoma.
Microscopic sections reveal moderate cellular atypia with hyperchromatic nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and desmoplastic stroma.
Surgical margins are evaluated and confirmed clear of invasive tumor cells. Lymphovascular invasion is not identified.

MOLECULAR & IMMUNOHISTOCHEMICAL TESTING:
Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) confirms activating EGFR driver alteration.
Pathologic Staging: Pathologic evaluation aligns with clinical Stage IV.
Recommendation: Correlation with systemic clinical oncology records and targeted therapy protocols.

Current Regimen: Docetaxel 144.8 mg

'I am reporting my daily symptoms since starting my recent cycle. I have been experiencing severe unbearable febrile neutropenia and severe fluid retention with inability to keep fluids down.
I am able to perform light activities around the house, but I felt much weaker yesterday.
I have no fever at home and no difficulty breathing when resting in bed.
Taking prescribed supportive medications with partial relief. Requesting callback from clinic nurse.'

ONCOLOGY CONSULTATION PROGRESS NOTE
Patient ID: PT-000258
Demographics: 60-year-old male presenting for Cycle 1 evaluation.

DIAGNOSIS & MOLECULAR PROFILING:
Primary Diagnosis: Stage IV SCLC.
Genomic Profile: Confirmed driver mutation in ALK. Secondary mutation: None/Unknown.
Tumor mutational burden measured at 2.6 mut/Mb with ctDNA level of 0.25 ng/mL.

CLINICAL ASSESSMENT & LABORATORY REVIEW:
Vitals: Blood pressure 151/95 mmHg, Heart rate 88 bpm, SpO2 95% on room air.
Serum Chemistries: Serum creatinine 1.23 mg/dL, Liver function enzymes 10.7 U/L, Hemoglobin 14.3 g/dL.
Patient currently demonstrates no acute adverse toxicities. Physical examination reveals no jaundice, no acute respiratory distress, and clear lung fields bilaterally.

TREATMENT PLAN & REGIMEN:
Administer scheduled therapy with Radiotherapy-SBRT at a dosage of 163.9 mg.
Pre-medications ordered per protocol. Serial monitoring of renal markers and complete blood count scheduled prior to next infusion.
